summary.text: Mariana Sandoval is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 23, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Sandoval graduated with a degree in Interdisciplinary and Paralegal Studies from Los Angeles Mission College and worked as a paralegal in legal aid and at the Arizona Attorney General's Office.

The profile says Sandoval served on the Agua Fria Union High School District Governing Board from January 2017 to December 2020 and was elected to the Arizona House in November 2022, serving since January 2023.
